brief:
Benjamin Netanyahu met Yaniv Hayun, a Flydubai passenger who helped restrain a pilot accused of stabbing a colleague during a flight, Al Jazeera English reported. The encounter marked a public recognition of Hayun's role in containing the incident aboard the aircraft.

Details of the stabbing attack and the circumstances leading to Hayun's intervention were not disclosed in the initial report.
dek: Benjamin Netanyahu has met Yaniv Hayun, the Flydubai passenger that helped restrain a pilot who stabbed a colleague.
title: Netanyahu meets passenger who subdued stabbing pilot
